checks.label: Accessible seating
checks.remediation: Add distributed accessible and companion seating positions.

checks.label: Accessible seating sightlines
checks.remediation: Move obstructions or relocate accessible seating samples until every section has a clear focal-point ray.

checks.label: Door clearance
checks.remediation: Clear the maneuvering zone and restore the required accessible door width.

checks.label: Temporary ramps
checks.remediation: Increase ramp run, clear width, landing, or edge protection and add required handrails.

checks.label: Turning clearance
checks.remediation: Increase the clear turning diameter at route junctions.

checks.label: Capacity
checks.remediation: Restore sufficient placed capacity or reduce the operational load.

checks.label: Catering readiness
checks.remediation: Resolve service capacity, queue, separation, access, support, or replenishment failures.

checks.label: Peak congestion
checks.remediation: Increase circulation width, reconnect occupied zones, or reduce phase demand.

checks.label: Emergency readiness
checks.remediation: Restore exit, assembly, emergency access, fire equipment, first-aid, and command-post readiness.

checks.label: Production readiness
checks.remediation: Resolve throw, visibility, audio, camera, cable, circuit, rigging, or inventory failures.

checks.label: Locked objects
checks.remediation: Remove Changes that target protected venue objects.

checks.label: Sightline coverage
checks.remediation: Move opaque obstructions or revise the seating section.
